swap_risks: HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LMV358IDR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=RR vs OPA2333AIDR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 6.3x (LMV358IDR: 1 V/µs p.7 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.16 V/µs p.7); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).
CAUTION PRECISION OFFSET SHIFT: Maximum Vos differs by 700x (LMV358IDR: 7 mV p.7 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.01 mV p.7); high-gain DC sensor stages may lose accuracy or require zero-drift chopper filtering.

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 214x (LMV358IDR: 15000 pA p.7 vs OPA2333AIDR: 70 pA p.7); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 6.2x (LMV358IDR: 105 µA/ch p.7 vs OPA2333AIDR: 17 µA/ch p.7); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: LMV358IDR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (5.5 V, p.5) than OPA2333AIDR (7 V, p.5); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 5.5 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 68% higher on LMV358IDR (LMV358IDR: 207.9 °C/W p.6 vs OPA2333AIDR: 124 °C/W p.6); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LMV358IDR requires Vs,min >= 2.7 V (p.5) vs 1.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: LMV358IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and OPA2333AIDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because rail-to-rail input/output swing differs; slew rate differs 6.3x; input offset voltage Vos differs 700x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 1 MHz (p.7) vs 0.35 MHz (p.7), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.5), Vos 7 mV (p.7) vs 0.01 mV (p.7), Ib 214x gap (15000 vs 70 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LMV358IDR "5.5 V Absolute Maximum Ceiling — Destructive If Swapped into LM358 High-Voltage Boards" (p.5) and OPA2333AIDR "Weak ±5 mA Output Drive and 350 kHz / 0.16 V/µs Speed vs Pin-Identical TLV9002/TLV9062/LMV358" (p.7). BOM decision: Choose LMV358IDR when closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 1 MHz GBWP; choose OPA2333AIDR when DC precision demands <= 0.01 mV max Vos or high-impedance sensors require pA-class input bias (70 pA). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
